{{Top|leg}}
'''Gladion Industries''' was a weapons manufacturer that was active during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The company was selling weapons to both sides, but once their actions were revealed to the public, they were forced to shut down and pay reparations.<ref name="Double-Dealing">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Diplomacy|Double-Dealing}}</ref>
